verdict.rationale: Meta's FAQ says the Llama models are hosted and distributed by AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and other partners, and a community report confirms Llama is a first-class option on AWS, Azure and GCP, so the major-cloud part of the story is delivered. The gateway/router part is not evidenced, and the specific managed services are not named, which limits coverage to partial. missing for 10: explicit evidence of availability via OpenRouter-class gateways or routers, explicit naming of Bedrock and Vertex as the hosting services, and documentation on whether the same model versions are offered consistently across providers.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint

citations.quote: Models are also hosted and distributed by partners such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, IBM Watsonx, Oracle Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, Dell, Hugging Face, Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova, and many others.
It is offered as a first class LLM option in AWS, Azure, GCP and all other major hosting providers.
